description: Fixed prompt set for the generation-quality eval harness (scripts/eval_generation.py). Expectations drive the structure metric; keep prompts stable so before/after comparisons stay meaningful.

prompts.prompt: build a humanoid robot with two arms, two legs, and a head camera
build a six-legged insect robot with antennae sensors and varied leg poses
build a four-wheeled rover with a front camera and a battery
build a tabletop robotic arm with a gripper
build a scorpion robot with a curled articulated tail, two pincer claws, and six walking legs
build an agile quadruped robot that uses quasi-direct-drive BLDC actuators for its leg joints instead of hobby servos, with a crouched stance and onboard battery and controller
build a four-wheeled rover where geared DC motors drive the wheels directly (no hub motors), with a front camera and a battery
